# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b36 — Managed controllers stay armed while hardware idles

The user observed the native More Info dialog of a Manager-created climate controller displaying **Off** and a selected target even while Control Method was Automatic or PID and its read-only status indicated `within_target_band`.

## Cause

The logical ManagedClimate.hvac_mode in beta35 intentionally reflected the **current physical source state**. If the heating/cooling/drying output was OFF because the measured value was within its target band or the controller was in a safe PID OFF interval, the entire logical climate appeared OFF. This incorrectly conflated a controller's selected mode with whether the physical device is currently energized.

## Repair

- The ManagedClimate entity now reports its **selected supervisory HVAC mode** (only an explicit supported selected direction, a runtime-evaluated supported direction, or the sole unambiguous advertised native direction).
- It reports **HVACAction.IDLE** when that logical mode remains selected but the physical source is OFF.
- Real native source observations remain separately visible in `physical_hvac_mode` and `physical_source_state` along with the existing `controller_status` and `control_mode` attributes. The physical device is never represented as heating/drying when it is actually OFF.
- Explicit controller Off continues to show Off. Existing/native passthrough continues to show the physical HVAC state. A multichannel controller with no selected or evaluated native direction is not assigned an invented operating mode.
- The heat/cool/fan/dry mode must be supported by that exact real physical device, never inferred from brand, name or a fabricated `AUTO` HVAC feature.

## Critical safety boundary

This release changes **presentation only**. It does not turn on/off physical equipment and does not bypass demand qualification, min OFF/min ON, PID/PWM duty cycle, mode consent, physical acknowledgement, occupancy, real sensor freshness, room ownership, window conditions, etc. An armed controller can remain IDLE for as long as no valid demand exists.

## Validation

CI covers native climate, humidifier and fan logical mode while their physical states remain OFF, explicit Off/Existing, manual selected HVAC mode, capability constraints, and physical state diagnostics. Python 3.13/3.14, installed HA 2026.10, HACS/Hassfest, 38-language catalogs, frontend card tests, and flat beta package extraction are required before publication.

Stable Latest remains v0.5.1. Only `environment_manager` is installed; b31–35 repairs are retained.
